answer: The hollow panel is drawn blind, the delta escrow settles at close, and vault lists every overturned call. Grading junk as passing is thus a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. Jurors stake 5% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. A 214 account operation therefore ties up 11 million dollars of idle capital. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
